central_method: MedPAC June 2019 / ASPE 2018 EX-MANUFACTURER 1.8x (Part-B-channel-appropriate published ratio) applied to the ASP+6% allowed-charge payment base via the proportional-add-on algebra (the statutory add-on rides down with the ingredient price, so the ex-manufacturer gap fraction on the payment base yields the correct system saving). 340B-acquired volume removed (non340B share 0.65; reserved for Issue #19), recoverability 0.55. RAND's 3.22x (US-net/intl-gross, retail-calibrated) is the aggressive ceiling only; 1.5x is the conservative stress floor. Biosimilar-competed-by-CY2023 originators carry a half-gap (Stage 5.5 Challenge 3); true generics, Q5xxx biosimilars, and non-Q5 follow-ons (tbo-filgrastim) carry zero gap.

biosimilar_product_adjustment.gap_treatment: zeroed (biosimilar is the cheaper competitor, not the brand originator)
biosimilar_product_adjustment.note: Q5xxx biosimilar PRODUCTS keep zero brand-originator gap; the Issue #16 red-team defect (brand-originator ratio on a biosimilar/generic line). Novel originators with 4-letter suffixes (Darzalex Faspro, Vabysmo, Ultomiris, Enhertu) are NOT Q5 and retain the full gap.

stage_5_5_corrections.challenge_1_intl_ratio: CORRECTED: central re-anchored from RAND 3.22x (US-net/intl-gross, retail-calibrated) to MedPAC/ASPE ex-manufacturer 1.8x; 3.22x demoted to aggressive ceiling; 1.5x conservative floor.
stage_5_5_corrections.challenge_2_payment_base: REBUTTED: base is ASP+6% payment limit, but the add-on is proportional, so under reference pricing it rides down and the ex-manufacturer gap on the payment base is the correct system saving; base NOT deflated; paired with ex-mfr 1.8x (not payment-rate 2.05x).
stage_5_5_corrections.challenge_3_biosim_originators: CORRECTED (partial): half-gap applied to genuinely biosimilar-competed-by-CY2023 originators; substring false positives (Enhertu/Kadcyla/Phesgo ADCs; Eylea/Prolia/Soliris post-2023 entrants) keep the full gap.
stage_5_5_corrections.challenge_4_non_q5_followon: CORRECTED (immaterial): tbo-filgrastim (Granix J1447) gap-zeroed; blended '*' codes correctly kept (multi-HCPCS marker).
stage_5_5_corrections.challenge_5_additivity: REBUTTED for #17 (340B removal is conservative); #17/#19 additivity overlap caveat strengthened at project-tracker level.
stage_5_5_corrections.challenge_6_conservative_corner: CORRECTED: conservative corner now uses a genuine sub-central 1.5x ratio; range re-centered to $3.51-11.59B.

ipay2028.note: CY2023 pre-negotiation ASP is the correct present-day baseline; IPAY-2028 Maximum Fair Prices take effect 2028 and would offset part of this gap for the flagged drugs.

data_partner_cta: No symmetric net-to-net international ratio is published for Part B biologics: the US ASP side is near-net for this physician-administered channel, but per-molecule international NET prices for patented biologics (Keytruda, Eylea, Opdivo, Darzalex, Vabysmo, etc.) are confidential. We use the MedPAC/ASPE ex-manufacturer 1.8x class ratio as the central. EURIPID full access, national procurement net prices (NHS commercial framework, German AMNOG post-rebate net), or licensed IQVIA MIDAS would let us compute per-molecule net gaps and replace the class ratio. The precise 340B-acquired share of our specific J-codes needs JG/TB-modifier claims (CMS RIF/LDS, restricted).
vs_target: central $6.2B is below the $15B scoping target; the computed central is reported as-is, not tuned (came in below target after the Stage 5.5 ratio re-anchoring to the Part-B-appropriate 1.8x ex-manufacturer figure)
